description: The HP-99 RTO serves as the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) for the Kotkhai region in the Shimla district. It functions under the jurisdiction of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and manages vehicle registrations and driving licenses. This RTO series became notable in 2023 for receiving record-breaking bids for premium vehicle registration numbers.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Kotkhai, District Shimla, Himachal Pradesh
